Exercise 15.9.43 — Draw a Silo (Spherical Coordinates)

Problem. Use a graphing device to draw a silo consisting of a cylinder with radius 3 and height 10 surmounted by a hemisphere.

Notation used in this solution

SymbolMeaning
R=3R = 3R=3, H=10H = 10H=10 Radius of the cylindrical wall and its height, measured along the zzz-axis from the bottom z=0z = 0z=0 to the rim z=10z = 10z=10.
hemisphere (dome) The half-sphere of radius R=3R = 3R=3 centered at (0,0,H)=(0,0,10)(0,0,H) = (0,0,10)(0,0,H)=(0,0,10) that sits on the rim of the cylinder. It is given by x2+y2+(z−10)2=9x^2 + y^2 + (z-10)^2 = 9x2+y2+(z−10)2=9 with z≥10z \ge 10z≥10.
(ρ,θ,φ)(\rho,\theta,\varphi)(ρ,θ,φ) Spherical coordinates, used to parameterise the dome: x=ρsin⁡φcos⁡θx = \rho\sin\varphi\cos\thetax=ρsinφcosθ, y=ρsin⁡φsin⁡θy = \rho\sin\varphi\sin\thetay=ρsinφsinθ, z=10+ρcos⁡φz = 10 + \rho\cos\varphiz=10+ρcosφ, with ρ=3\rho = 3ρ=3, 0≤φ≤π/20 \le \varphi \le \pi/20≤φ≤π/2.

Part 1 — Draw the silo

Step 1.1: Fix the dimensions and the two pieces.

The silo has two pieces:

  • Cylindrical wall: the points x2+y2=9x^2 + y^2 = 9x2+y2=9 with 0≤z≤100 \le z \le 100≤z≤10, plus the bottom disk x2+y2≤9x^2 + y^2 \le 9x2+y2≤9 in the plane z=0z = 0z=0.
  • Dome: the hemisphere x2+y2+(z−10)2=9x^2 + y^2 + (z-10)^2 = 9x2+y2+(z−10)2=9, z≥10z \ge 10z≥10, which is glued to the cylinder along the rim circle x2+y2=9x^2 + y^2 = 9x2+y2=9, z=10z = 10z=10.

The dome is a hemisphere of the same radius as the cylinder (radius 3), since it must close exactly the circular top of the cylinder. Its highest point is (0,0,13)(0,0,13)(0,0,13), so the total height of the silo is 10+3=1310 + 3 = 1310+3=13.

Step 1.2: Verify the geometry with SymPy.

The script solution/part1_step1.py confirms three facts: the rim at z=10z = 10z=10 is the circle x2+y2=9x^2 + y^2 = 9x2+y2=9 of radius 3; the top of the dome profile z=10+9−x2−y2z = 10 + \sqrt{9 - x^2 - y^2}z=10+9−x2−y2​ is at z=13z = 13z=13; and (as context for the figure) the total volume is πR2H+23πR3=90π+18π=108π≈339.292\pi R^2 H + \frac{2}{3}\pi R^3 = 90\pi + 18\pi = 108\pi \approx 339.292πR2H+32​πR3=90π+18π=108π≈339.292.

Step 1.3: Draw the silo.

Fig. 2 is a labelled cross section that shows the dimensions explicitly: cylinder radius 3, height 10, dome radius 3, and total height 13.

Result. The required deliverable is the figure: a silo with a cylindrical part of radius 3 and height 10 (zzz from 0 to 10) surmounted by a hemisphere of radius 3 centered at (0,0,10)(0,0,10)(0,0,10). Its total height is 13 and its total volume is 108π108\pi108π.
